name: 金属管身缎光显色唇膏款
description: 香槟金属管身，膏体微距与多肤色试色色带的唇部彩妆套图

styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless studio white #FFFFFF for packshots, macro textures and flat infographics, alternating with warm neutral matte panels #F4EDE6, thin champagne-metal frame lines #C9A96B on the framed screens
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright even high-key studio light, front-left softbox key with fill card, butterfly beauty light on skin crops, controlled narrow speculars on the polished metal, soft contact shadows only
styleLock.surfaceSystem: seamless white sweep and warm matte board #F4EDE6, flat overhead surface, no visible table edge or horizon
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif for every headline, label and small-print line, one family only; all in-image copy supplied as placeholders at generation time
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons and blank rounded pill labels outlined in champagne metal #C9A96B, no filled illustrative icons
styleLock.presentationRules: tube kept upright and at a stable scale across the set, one long vertical highlight on each face of the polished case, bullet and lip color always carried by the accent placeholder rather than a fixed hue
noDrift: no fixed lip shade hue across the set
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent polished champagne-metal lipstick visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless studio white #FFFFFF, warm neutral matte #F4EDE6, champagne metal #C9A96B and charcoal text #33302E, with bullet and lip color always carried by one accent placeholder; bright even high-key studio lighting with a front-left softbox key and fill, butterfly light on skin crops, controlled narrow speculars on polished metal and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif typography only; thin single-weight line icons and blank rounded pill labels; stable upright tube scale and placement with one long vertical highlight on the case; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，用开盖立管与并列盖体交代管身装潢与膏体形态
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, tube upright and centered, cap standing beside it, full product visible
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light, front-left softbox key with fill card, narrow vertical highlights on the polished case, soft contact shadows
shots.props: the matching cap standing upright beside the tube
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace, even margin above and below the tube
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. One uncapped tube standing upright with its cap placed beside it, photographed straight-on at eye-level, full product visible and nothing cropped by the frame edge, the exposed bullet rendered in the accent color carried by {accent_color}. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a front-left softbox key and a fill card on the shadow side, one narrow vertical highlight running down each face of the polished case, soft contact shadows grounding both pieces. Seamless studio white background #FFFFFF. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame. No extra whitespace beyond an even margin above and below the tube. 8K commercial beauty e-commerce quality. Negative: no engraved or printed lettering on the bullet, no wordmark on the centre band, no props other than the cap, no hands, no watermark, no QR code, no tinted or gradient background, no floating product without a contact shadow, no cut-off edges.

shots.intent: 承接主图，一秒交代上唇后的着色结果与膏体光泽
shots.camera: matched tight close-ups of the lower face, each panel straight-on at eye-level with identical crop
shots.lighting: soft butterfly beauty light from front-above with gentle fill, one controlled specular on the lip surface
shots.background: warm neutral matte gutters #F4EDE6 separating the panels
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace beyond the thin gutters between panels
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero showing {product} worn on lips. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Three matched tight close-up panels of an anonymous lower face cropped above the nose so that only the lips and the tip of the nose are visible, each panel photographed straight-on at eye-level with an identical crop and framing, the lips tinted with the accent carried by {accent_color}. Soft butterfly beauty light from front-above with gentle fill, one controlled specular on the lip surface, real skin texture with visible fine lines and pores. Warm neutral matte gutters #F4EDE6 separate the panels. The lips fill 50-60% of the frame. No extra whitespace beyond the thin gutters between panels. Negative: no eyes, brows or any other identifying facial feature, no recognizable person, no plastic airbrushed skin, no flaking or cracked lips invented as a result claim, no in-image copy or shade codes, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 用膏体抹开的旋纹与光泽证明质地绵密，替代成分与功效说教
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro from a high 45-degree angle looking down onto the smeared cream
shots.lighting: skimming side light from the upper left revealing the swept ridges, one clean highlight per ridge crest
shots.whitespace: minimal whitespace, the swirl fills the vertical frame
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of the creamed formula taken from {product}, a broad sculpted swirl smeared across the frame in the accent color carried by {accent_color}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down onto the swirl, shallow depth of field with the ridge crests sharp and the trailing edge falling softly out of focus. Skimming side light from the upper left revealing the swept ridges and glossy peaks, one clean highlight per ridge crest. Seamless studio white background #FFFFFF. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame. Minimal whitespace; the swirl is the whole subject and runs edge to edge in a vertical 4:5 crop. Negative: no blurry subject, no cracked, crumbly or melted texture, no fingerprints, dust or tool marks, no duplicated swirl elements, no color banding artifacts, no in-image text, no watermark.

shots.intent: 以闭合管身的镜面金属与腰封结构交代装潢做工，支撑质感卖点
shots.camera: photographed from a very low angle looking slightly upward, capped tube upright and centered
shots.lighting: high-key studio light with two softbox strips, one long vertical highlight per face, deep mirror falloff at the edges, tight soft contact shadow
shots.whitespace: even breathing space on both sides of the tube
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product} closed. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The capped tube standing upright and centered, photographed from a very low angle looking slightly upward so the case reads tall and sculptural, full product visible with clean margins above and below. High-key studio lighting with two softbox strips producing one long vertical highlight on each face of the polished case, deep mirror falloff along the edges, a tight soft contact shadow at the base. Warm neutral matte background #F4EDE6. The product occupies 50-60% of the frame. Even breathing space on both sides of the tube. Negative: no engraved lettering on the centre band, no wordmark or logo of any kind, no fingerprints or smudges on the metal, no bent or warped tube edges, no reflected crew or studio clutter in the mirror finish, no in-image text, no cut-off edges.

shots.intent: 把机制说明转成三枚留空论证位，真实资料在生成时才填入
shots.camera: straight-on flat infographic layout, tube on the left at a slight 3/4 angle
shots.lighting: even high-key flat lighting, soft drop shadows beneath the circular wells
shots.background: seamless studio white #FFFFFF with a thin champagne-metal border #C9A96B
shots.props: three empty circular wells with thin champagne-metal outlines #C9A96B
shots.whitespace: clear side margins around the disc cluster
shots.textZone: one headline line across the top and one short label beneath each of the three circular wells
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce mechanism infographic for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on flat layout with the opened tube on the left at a slight 3/4 angle and its bullet in the accent color carried by {accent_color}, and on the right three empty circular wells arranged in a loose triangle, every disc left as a blank placeholder reserved for a texture or material image supplied at generation time, one short label beneath each disc reading 「{callout_1}」 「{callout_2}」 「{callout_3}」 and one headline line 「{selling_point_1}」 across the top in charcoal #33302E. Even high-key flat lighting with soft drop shadows beneath the discs. Seamless studio white background #FFFFFF framed by a thin champagne-metal border #C9A96B. The product occupies 50-60% of the frame. Clear side margins around the disc cluster. Negative: no ingredient names, no percentage or quantity figures, no clinical or efficacy wording, no filled-in copy beyond the placeholders, no tiny unreadable text, no photographic content inside the empty wells, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 用不同肤色前臂上的色卡条交代选色逻辑，让买家先定位自己的肤色
shots.camera: photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle, four forearms laid parallel
shots.lighting: even high-key flat lighting, soft contact shadows along the outer edge of each arm
shots.props: one closed tube loosely held in the hands at the frame edges, a vertical column of blank rounded swatch pills on each arm
shots.whitespace: even margins between the four arm columns
shots.textZone: one short blank label slot beside each swatch column
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce variant chart for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Four anonymous forearms of visibly different skin tones laid parallel from wrist to elbow, photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle on a flat surface, each arm carrying one vertical column of blank rounded swatch pills in the accent color carried by {accent_color}, every pill left unprinted with no code or number on it. Hands loosely holding one closed tube each at the frame edges, fingers relaxed and correctly formed. Even high-key flat lighting with soft contact shadows along the outer edge of each arm. Warm neutral matte background #F4EDE6. The arms and swatch columns occupy 60-70% of the frame overall. Even margins between the four columns. Negative: no faces, no readable shade numbers or handwritten marks, no duplicated or merged arms, no deformed or extra fingers, no banding or fake texture inside the pills, no in-image text, no watermark.

shots.intent: 以九格上唇效果墙完成选色决策，色带范围只留标题占位不写数量
shots.camera: matched frontal tight close-ups repeated in a three-by-three grid, identical crop in every panel
shots.lighting: identical soft butterfly light in every panel, one controlled specular on the lip surface
shots.background: seamless studio white #FFFFFF inside a thin champagne-metal frame #C9A96B
shots.whitespace: open bands between the rows and around the outer frame
shots.textZone: one clear headline band across the centre of the grid
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce shade wall for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. A three-by-three grid of matched tight close-ups of an anonymous lower face cropped above the nose, only the lips visible, shown across visibly different skin tones, each panel photographed straight-on at eye-level with an identical crop, all lips tinted inside the single accent family carried by {accent_color}. Identical soft butterfly light in every panel with one controlled specular on the lip surface. Seamless studio white background #FFFFFF inside a thin champagne-metal frame #C9A96B, with one clear headline band across the centre carrying only the placeholder 「{selling_point_2}」 in charcoal #33302E. The grid occupies 60-70% of the frame overall. Open bands between the rows and around the outer frame. Negative: no eyes or identifying facial features, no recognizable person, no numeric shade counts or range figures, no readable shade codes, no lighting drift between panels, no duplicated panel, no watermark, no extra text beyond the placeholder.

shots.intent: 以管底标贴结构收口消除真伪与色号错发顾虑，全部字面留空待真实资料
shots.camera: photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle onto the flat base of the tube
shots.lighting: even high-key studio light, one broad soft highlight sweeping across the polished rim, soft contact shadow beneath the tube
shots.whitespace: generous empty margin outside the rim
shots.promptTemplate: Close-up product detail of {product} turned base-up. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The flat rounded-square base of the closed tube photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle, filling the centre of the frame, its inlaid label field left as a clean unprinted surface with one large blank code frame, one blank name line and two short blank small-print lines, no legible characters anywhere. Even high-key studio light with one broad soft highlight sweeping across the polished rim and a soft contact shadow beneath the tube. Warm neutral matte background #F4EDE6. The base fills 55-60% of the frame. Generous empty margin outside the rim. Negative: no brand wordmark, no distributor name, city or postal address, no shade number or letters, no barcode or QR code, no garbled or invented characters, no scratched or dented metal, no watermark.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：1 白底开盖立管，膏体外露、盖体并列右侧，膏体斜面与腰封带圈处原有蚀刻字样；2 三格不同肤色唇部特写加一格膏体色块，色块上原有数字与色号名；3 四条不同肤色前臂并列俯拍，每臂一列带编号的色卡条，掌中各握一支闭口管；4 白底信息图，左侧膏体带水珠特写、右侧三枚圆形成分气泡与一句大字百分比标题，外框红色描边；5 三行三列九格唇部特写墙，中央白色标题带原为色号数量文案，四周香槟色描边；6 俯拍管底方形圆角金属边与内嵌标贴，标贴上是系列名、大号数字色号、色号名与分销商名称地址；7 白底满幅膏体旋抹特写，竖构图；8 白底闭口管正面直拍，腰封带圈处有蚀刻字样。品类判定：全部图像围绕唇部着色产品的膏体形态、上唇效果与色号体系展开，属着色彩妆而非护理清洁，故判美妆彩妆/唇部，与主会话给出的品类提示一致。已剥离：品牌字标与蚀刻字样、系列名、色号编号与色号名、分销商名称与地址、成分名称与百分比及一切功效主张、原图英文文案原句与红色描边配色，一律改为 {product} 占位、空白论证圆盘、未印色卡药丸与未印管底标贴；唇色与膏体颜色一律由 {accent_color} 承载，不锁死具体色相；人物仅保留匿名下半脸与唇部、颈部以下的前臂与手部，无眼鼻以上特征与身份线索。
